entries.question: I purchased the Allianz Adventure Pack, but I was injured while riding a motorcycle without a helmet. Would the claim be covered?
entries.answer:
Based on the provided policy document excerpts, the claim would not be covered.

[Source 1: ALLIANZ_20251219.pdf, page 17]
"No cover will apply under Benefits 1.5 Permanent Disability or 6.1 Personal Liability for any claims arising from, or in any way connected with you participating in any of the activities listed in the Adventure Pack."

[Source 2: ALLIANZ_20251219.pdf, page 9]
"You will not have cover under Benefits 1.5 Permanent Disability and 6.1 Personal Liability for any claims arising from your participation in any of the activities listed under Adventure Pack or your participation in snow sport activities."

[Source 3: ALLIANZ_20251219.pdf, page 13]
"You will not have cover under Benefits 1.5 Permanent Disability and 6.1 Personal Liability for any claims arising from your participation in any of the activities listed under Adventure Pack or your participation in snow sport activities."

Since you purchased the Allianz Adventure Pack and were injured while riding a motorcycle without a helmet, the claim would not be covered as it falls under the excluded activities listed in the policy.

entries.question: I fell and needed medical treatment after drinking heavily, and a blood test recorded a BAC of 0.20%. Would Medibank cover the medical claim?
entries.answer:
Based on the provided policy document excerpts, the answer is:

No, Medibank would not cover the medical claim.

[Source 2, page 42] states: "20. claims involving, arising from or related to Your impairment due to You drinking too much alcohol: ... which is evidenced by the results of a blood test which shows that Your blood alcohol concentration level is 0.19% or above."

Since the blood test recorded a BAC of 0.20%, which is above the threshold of 0.19%, this claim would be excluded according to the policy.
